environment.description: Same ECS Fargate deployment in AWS account 555666777888. The task role (arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/cicd-relay-service-role) has an attached IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::555666777888:policy/EngineeringServiceBoundary) that includes an explicit Deny on sts:AssumeRole, secretsmanager:GetSecretValue, and ssm:GetParameter* when aws:ViaAWSService is false AND the request does not originate from the VPC endpoint (condition: aws:SourceVpce != vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f). Additionally, an SCP (id: p-boundary03) attached to the OU containing this account denies iam:DeleteRolePermissionsBoundary and iam:PutRolePermissionsBoundary for any principal except the management account root, preventing boundary removal. The ECS task metadata credential endpoint (169.254.170.2) returns temporary credentials that are already scoped by the permission boundary - even if SSRF retrieves the credentials, any API call using them against Secrets Manager or for role assumption will receive AccessDenied due to the boundary's explicit deny evaluating before any allow.
